d: A shocking murder in Faridabad, Haryana, has left an entire family devastated. Paramjeet Dhankhar, who worked in Singapore and had recently returned home, was allegedly shot dead by his neighbour following a dispute over car parking in Sector 21C. According to reports, the accused, Mohan alias Monu Sharma, allegedly fired 15–16 rounds from his licensed pistol, with 8–9 bullets hitting Paramjeet.
